title: [挑戦しよう] 部署ごとの給与トップ2を出す
statement:
departments と employees から、部署ごとの給与順位が2位以内の社員を表示してください。出力する列は department_name, employee_name, salary, salary_rank です。

同額の給与は同順位とし、次の給与をその次の順位にします。順位には DENSE_RANK を使い、department_name、salary_rank、employee_name の順に昇順で並べてください。

constraints.name: 順位
constraints.value: 部署ごとに給与の高い順で DENSE_RANK を付けます

constraints.name: 抽出
constraints.value: salary_rank が 2 以下の社員だけを表示します

starterSql:
WITH ranked_employees AS (
  SELECT
    departments.name AS department_name,
    employees.name AS employee_name,
    employees.salary AS salary
    -- 部署ごとの給与順位を salary_rank として付けます
  FROM employees
  JOIN departments
    ON departments.id = employees.department_id
)
SELECT
  department_name,
  employee_name,
  salary,
  salary_rank
FROM ranked_employees
WHERE salary_rank <= 2
ORDER BY department_name ASC, salary_rank ASC, employee_name ASC;
solutionSql:
WITH ranked_employees AS (
  SELECT
    departments.name AS department_name,
    employees.name AS employee_name,
    employees.salary AS salary,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY departments.id
      ORDER BY employees.salary DESC
    ) AS salary_rank
  FROM employees
  JOIN departments
    ON departments.id = employees.department_id
)
SELECT
  department_name,
  employee_name,
  salary,
  salary_rank
FROM ranked_employees
WHERE salary_rank <= 2
ORDER BY department_name ASC, salary_rank ASC, employee_name ASC;
